preconditions: Disposable VM or explicitly designated host with PID 1 systemd
Exact Nightshift binary, unit, timer, configuration, and source identities captured
Canonical cycle requests are posture-only or use a non-effecting AG fixture
The host clock is synchronized and not modified by this plan
procedure: Run preflight.py --profile trusted-host and save systemd-analyze/systemctl identities
Install the exact canonical service/timer into the isolated host without legacy units
Start one on-time slot and capture journal, timer properties, SQLite replay, and cycle identity
Stop or power off across more than one timer interval, then boot with Persistent=true
Capture the generated catch-up slot, trigger classification, exact cycle identity, and absence of duplicate attempts
Restart the service and timer independently during idle and active-cycle boundaries
Verify prior diagnostic/support bytes remain historical and live leases/currentness are not reconstructed
Seal unit files, manager properties, monotonic/realtime coordinates, boot IDs, journals, database, and replay output
forbidden_shortcuts: Calling deterministic slot tests real systemd evidence
Using diagnostic generation equality as slot satisfaction
Allowing a catch-up timer to authorize work
